summary: Authorities have closed at least 14 Tesco supermarkets located in Lancashire, Suffolk, Dyfed Powys, Fife, Leicestershire, Humberside, West Mercia, West Yorkshire, Nottinghamshire, Strathclyde and London after receiving a security alert; witnesses say authorities received a bomb threat and that the stores' car parks have been blocked off by police. A worker near a Tesco in Barrhead, East Renfrewshire said police suggested they close but their manager kept them open, while a Hertfordshire police officer said police are investigating a series of incidents involving Tesco stores, Tesco is working with the police and "these stores have been temporarily closed as a precaution for public safety"; police said they are treating their enquiries as a criminal investigation, no injuries are reported and officers will remain at the stores until further notice.
